title: Detection of GFP-tagged Multispanning Transmembrane Proteins in HEK293T Cells
author: Danara Vonk
materials: Determine total protein concentration of samples.

steps.title: Seed HEK293T cells
steps.instruction: Seed 3 × 10⁶ HEK293T cells per 10 cm dish in DMEM supplemented with 10 % FBS, 100 U/mL penicillin and 100 µg/mL streptomycin.

steps.title: Incubate cells overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate the seeded dishes at 37 °C in a humidified incubator with 5 % CO₂ overnight.

steps.title: Prepare transfection reagents
steps.instruction: In a sterile tube (Tube A) mix 5 µg plasmid DNA with 500 µL DMEM without additives. In a second tube (Tube B) mix 10 µL PEI (1 mg/mL) with 500 µL DMEM without additives. Incubate both tubes 5 min at room temperature, then add the contents of Tube B to Tube A and incubate 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add transfection mix to cells
steps.instruction: Gently add the 800 µL transfection mixture to the cells dropwise, then return the dishes to 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ and grow overnight.

steps.title: Wash cells
steps.instruction: Remove medium and wash the cells twice with 1× PBS.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and scrape
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Lysis Buffer I to each 10 cm dish, immediately scrape the cells off the surface, and collect the lysate.

steps.title: Collect and sonicate lysate
steps.instruction: Transfer the scraped material into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, sonicate 3 × 3 s pulses at 50 % amplitude (Branson settings), then incubate on ice for 30 min.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 10 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, transfer the supernatant to a new tube, and heat the sample for 5 min at 55 °C.

steps.title: Prepare samples for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Adjust each sample to a final protein concentration of 2 µg/µL and add 1× Laemmli buffer (see buffer list).

steps.title: Prepare buffers
steps.instruction: If a storage temperature is not specified, keep the buffer at room temperature. Prepare the following buffers:

substeps.instruction: Lysis Buffer I: 50 mM Tris pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 1 % v/v Triton X‑100, 0.1 % v/v SDS, 5 mM EDTA; store at 4 °C.
Tris 1 (0.5 M): 0.5 M Tris pH 6.8, 0.1 % v/v SDS.
Tris 2 (1.5 M): 1.5 M Tris pH 8.8, 0.1 % v/v SDS.
Laemmli Buffer (5×): 12.5 % w/v SDS, 50 % v/v glycerol, 300 mM Tris pH 6.8, 0.05 % w/v bromophenol blue, 20 % v/v β‑mercaptoethanol; store at –20 °C.
Running Buffer (10×): 0.25 M Tris, 1.92 M glycine, 1 % w/v SDS.
Transfer Buffer (1.25×): 25 mM Tris, 192 mM glycine; store at 4 °C.
Ponceau S staining solution: 0.1 % w/v Ponceau S, 5 % v/v glacial acetic acid.

steps.title: Make 1× transfer buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200 mL 100 % methanol to 800 mL 1.25× Transfer Buffer to obtain 1× Transfer Buffer.

steps.title: Load and run SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Load the prepared samples onto the desired percentage SDS‑PAGE gel, run at 100 V for 10 min, then increase to 150 V and continue until proteins have migrated as far as possible without running off the gel.

steps.title: Transfer proteins to membrane
steps.instruction: Perform a wet transfer onto a nitrocellulose membrane at 110 V for 70 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Stain membrane with Ponceau S
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane in Ponceau S staining solution for 3 min on a shaker, then wash 3 × 5 min with PBS‑T on a shaker.

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10 % (w/v) skim‑milk solution in PBS‑T and incubate the membrane for 1 h at room temperature on a shaker.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane overnight at 4 °C on a roller in mouse anti‑GFP antibody (Takara Bio Living Colours, JL‑8; 1 : 1000) diluted in 3 % BSA in PBS‑T.

steps.title: Wash after primary
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane 3 × 5 min with PBS‑T on a shaker, then quickly rinse 2–3 times with PBS‑T to remove residual blocking solution.

steps.title: Incubate with secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane for 1.5 h at room temperature in goat‑anti‑mouse Alexa 680‑conjugated antibody (Life Technologies; 1 : 7500) diluted in 3 % BSA in PBS‑T, protecting the membrane from light.

steps.title: Final washes
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane 3 × 5 min with PBS‑T on a shaker.

steps.title: Image fluorescence signal
steps.instruction: Develop and image the protein signal on a Li‑Cor Odyssey Fc imaging system using the 700 nm channel.
